packages.title: GPT-6 Astra Changes What a Computer Can Do
packages.pairing_philosophy: Title provides authoritative technical framing; thumbnail creates immediate personal curiosity.
packages.description:
What happens when artificial intelligence stops waiting for human instructions and starts navigating operating systems on its own? In this investigative technical documentary, we examine OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra—inspecting primary source documentation, verified OSWorld 2.0 benchmark telemetry (72.6%), live closed-loop terminal debugging, and the critical cybersecurity implications disclosed in OpenAI's safety assessment.

0:00 - The Silent Workstation
0:15 - Astra Takes the Helm
0:31 - The Paradigm Shift
0:40 - The Empirical Evidence
0:55 - Closed-Loop Self-Correction
1:10 - Critical Cybersecurity Threshold
1:22 - Who's Actually in Control?

Sources & Primary Evidence:
- OpenAI GPT-6 Astra Foundation Announcement (Sept 3, 2026)
- OSWorld 2.0 Benchmark Technical Evaluation Report
- OpenAI Preparedness Safety Overview: Frontier Risk in Astra
